name: a non-covering Deny does not remove COMPUTE-CODE-OVERWRITE (deny witness)
note: Stage-16 deny witness: a Deny on an UNRELATED action does not suppress the standalone compute-overwrite grant, so COMPUTE-CODE-OVERWRITE still fires; no iam:PassRole so no PASSROLE path.
rationale: An explicit Deny on an UNRELATED action (lambda:DeleteFunction) does not cover the overwrite grant (lambda:UpdateFunctionCode), so the standalone code-overwrite capability survives and COMPUTE-CODE-OVERWRITE fires. Witnesses the rule's interaction with a present-but-non-covering Deny.
